facts.fact: DTW 落地（雪夜底特律）——以「见网友」告诉父母；旧模拟电视从阁楼常驻卧室；「suspected murderer 同一四面墙里的短暂喘息」；Erin 失踪一年 gazebo 烛光守夜（他躲在后排被盯）；证据链时间线网站（homecoming 前走廊争吵/失夜淤痕/deranged screeds uploads）——「too circumstantial for arrest. But court of public opinion near unanimous」；毕业礼被喊 Murderer
facts.anchor: A short reprieve from life inhabiting the same four walls as a suspected murderer

facts.fact: Jim 消失：向警察解释 Jim 的角色被「almost laughed out of the interrogation room」——「O. J. Simpson had a more believable patsy. All traces scrubbed、学校无档案」——「Probably in another town somewhere else, searching for his next victim. The next tape in his collection. The next photo on his wall.」；PAA 广播随 Erin 消失即停（为 Erin 的眼睛独播）——「swallowed up the person it really wanted, and then it moved on」；Auxiliaries 毕业/Jim/Erin 皆走——「lost to that faraway realm where David couldn't ever hope to follow」——「He kept the faith because it was all he could do to calm his guilt: the aching part…and the rotten part, too, that felt responsible for her fate.」
facts.anchor: O. J. Simpson had a more believable patsy.

facts.fact: 社媒时代自建：Facebook groups/Twitter feeds/Tumblr→私密论坛；封杀坚称他是凶手的 troll、只留 true believers；上传 hours of recordings/vlogs 到 YouTube/GlobalVill proselytize——「wasn't proud of the audience: fringe conspiracy theorists. Online loners dissatisfied with 'reality.' A deep anger in all of them. Even in Emily, his first and most dedicated acolyte——given up on real life long ago、chasing any sufficient excuse for radicalization. A cause not so much to live for, but to provide sufficient cover for withdrawal.」——「He wasn't in a position to be choosy.」
facts.anchor: A cause not so much to live for, but to provide sufficient cover for withdrawal.

facts.fact: 静电监听升级：睡时录带晨间快进回放；Senior year 后热浪——不再出门（微波炉 Hot Pockets=妈妈「still loved him without having to actually get too involved in whatever horror show」）；disturbances 重启（as if forced by sheer willpower）——脑内 zap 与屏上 zap 同刻——学会半睡态 commune（keep calm、防 feed short out）——「And then, finally, he heard her. 'Hello…? Hello…?'」——信号单向（police mirror 的比喻）——Erin 渐长讯息：「I don't know where I am, and it's hard to think…But I saw them. I saw someone glowing in the airwaves.」→两周后「…Chloe Edmonds. Forty-four Lake Drive Place in Allen Park, Michigan. I saw her on Pink Eye TV. I think she might be bright enough to save me.」
facts.anchor: He learned to commune with it

facts.fact: Chloe 调查：google+网友（online stalking experts）证实 16 岁 Chloe 住址属实；她的频道开头「You're watching Pink Eye TV, and this is an episode for whoever's out there listening」——左眼 conjunctivitis 红肿过半脸；口述 Officer Sunday 侦探剧（1960s LA、Raymond Chandler 式 hard-boiled dialogue、四个 fake act breaks）——David 觉得熟悉：追随者分钟解谜——「Sunday's Best was an actual detective show that had aired on the CBS Network between 1959 and 1965.」
facts.anchor: Sunday’s Best was an actual detective show

facts.fact: 招募与吻：Chloe 回信（honored——David 七位数播放 vs 她的 20 streams、看了他全部、I love mysteries…It's like stuff I've known about all my life, but that I never had the words to express）——「Chloe's message gave David an erection, even though he knew it shouldn't.」；机场 diner：她挠肿眼下皮（eyepatch 到校=11 年级 fashion statement）；「It helps me…putting myself in the shoes of a detective…feel like I'm in control. Like I don't have to be myself anymore. It's an escape.」——「Why Sunday's Best?」——「I've never even heard of it in my entire life.」——摊牌（Erin 被骗/播放 Erin 视频口播地址/psychic connection 的 sitcom 集数后她离开了世界）——「I'm pretty sure you're one of the special ones, like Erin. Maybe you can even save her.」；给 Erin 年鉴照（「Try to save her. Try to bring her back.」）——Chloe「Does it hurt? What they do to you down there?」（curious>scared）——停车场她吻他、他闪避「That's not why I'm here」——「I'm sorry…this is all so exciting. That you think I'm special. That you believe I have a destiny.」——「Nothing ever happens here. Nothing ever happens.」
facts.anchor: That you believe I have a destiny.

facts.fact: 尾声：一周后最后一信（researching 1960s detective shows—Sunday's Best/Dragnet/Mannix——「I'm pretty sure I made them all…」）——两天后 Google Alert：Chloe 失踪三日无note——记 spreadsheet/私坛发帖——「Nothing of the sort ever occurred. Because Chloe hadn't been the one…quite powerful enough to claw her way back to earth with David's lost love in tow.」——回归日常监听等 Erin——「Erin had been his first. The first girl David had helped send to that place. And it had been so painful, he almost couldn't go on after she disappeared. But Chloe had been his first, too, just in a different way. His first that felt easy.」
